visual_review.priority: Keep the original slash art and the feeling of a bright laboratory.

observations.B: Brightest room, but the pastel slash edge remains relatively weak against the similarly bright floor.
observations.C: The preferred balance for a bright facility: white walls stay dominant, the warm gray floor looks lighter and less muted than D, and reduced pattern contrast lets both original slash colors read without added decoration.
observations.D: Stronger silhouette separation than C, with a slightly darker and greener floor. A useful background-only fallback if movement testing reveals weak edges in C.

visual_review.recommendation: Prefer C (#B0ADA1) as the starting option when bright facility atmosphere has priority. Keep D (#A3A596) as the contrast-oriented alternative. This is an art review recommendation, not a user selection or production change.
visual_review.required_changes: None for the comparison study. Do not change slash color, alpha, shape, width or add an outline.

limitations: Static original-art compositions only; no Unity import, gameplay execution or runtime modification.
Source-color luminance numbers help compare options but do not establish gameplay readability or accessibility compliance.
The cyan source is mirrored consistently for the comparison only; its stored source file and all original RGBA pixel values are unchanged.
Only this report was written. The production artwork and Unity assets remain untouched.
next_validation_after_selection: Compare the chosen background with the unchanged full slash animation during actual movement and enemy/projectile overlap. If adjustment is needed, continue with floor brightness and pattern contrast.
